I won't pretend that's new, because you've heard it. What's different: it's in front of JD and Georges now as one case, with the firmware string, the failed flash, and the fact you paid for the Harlo OS Diagnostics and RMA line on Shop····, which makes this ours to settle, not yours to chase.

I can't approve a replacement myself. If nobody is in here with you shortly, the answer goes to (email hidden), and you won't have to repeat any of it.
You are right, the good news is, I got 3 more emails, to rate you on Trust Pilot, here comes some more 1 plus downgrade as many as I can.

Fair enough. Rate it however you see it, that's yours to write and I won't ask you to soften it.

The review emails going out while your case sits unanswered is a bad look, and I'm sorry you got three of them. I've noted that on the ticket so they stop while this is open.

What I care about more is the BC04. It's with JD and Georges now with everything on it. Nothing else from me until one of them answers you.
That is what one of the emails wants me to rate.

Right, asking you to rate the very unit that turned up without the firmware you paid for. That's the automated post-delivery mail going out on Shop····, and it shouldn't have while the case is open.

Rate it honestly, that's not something I'd argue with.

The B.04 itself is still the thing to fix. It's with JD and Georges now with the firmware string and the failed flash on it.
